prompts.elenco: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished landscape character proposal sheet for the Mexican supernatural deduction board game Noche de Ánimas. Input image 1 is ONLY reference for existing human faces and clothes; it is a collage of actual cards. Input 2 is the approved illustration style master, not the requested scene. Input 3 supplies architecture/palette only. Design FOUR full-length HUMAN investigators standing separately on a warm ivory printed-paper background, balanced individual three-quarter poses, feet fully visible, large readable faces, subtle decorative top border and small name captions beneath. No card frames, no powers, no ghosts on this sheet. Four distinct adult faces, not repeated faces in different clothes. Left to right: INÉS, age about32, dark thick braid gathered low, oval face strong brows gold hoop earrings and one small orange marigold, ivory blouse with burgundy floral embroidery, plum full skirt, magenta rebozo, holding an old-fashioned lantern in one anatomically correct hand and a closed notebook under the other arm. RAFAEL about40, slightly broad shoulders, wavy dark hair short connected beard and moustache, beige rolled-sleeve shirt, green utility vest with simple pockets, red neckerchief, brown trousers and practical shoes; holds just one green handheld EMF meter, keep faithful to man in card Respirar hondo. TOMÁS about48, long face, prominent moustache but NO full beard, small brimmed teal hat, ivory shirt, dark braces, teal/petroleum poncho with cream geometric woven borders draped over one shoulder, brown satchel, writes on small notebook with pencil. AMALIA about58, distinct angular mature face gently suggested age without realistic wrinkles, long dark braid with a few gray strands, cream rebozo with restrained burgundy floral embroidery, moss-green full skirt, gold hoops; holds a small bunch of rue, composed watchful expression, not a witch caricature. All clothing consistent with existing cards and no weapons. Text captions EXACTLY: 'INÉS', 'RAFAEL', 'TOMÁS', 'AMALIA'. Style MUST closely match approved source cards: Mexican folk narrative board-game illustration, paper-collage-like shapes with moderate illustrated volume, layered midtones, clear anatomy and articulated hands, selective embroidery and cloth folds, fine perceptible ink grain and paper texture. Matte illustration with teal, cream, burgundy, magenta, muted greens and orange accents. Not photoreal, not 3D, not anime, not children's cartoon, not minimal flat vector, no uniform black outlines, no glossy highlights, no magical glow, no cinematic volumetric light, no excessive microtexture. Maintain warmth and mystery through faces and posture. This is a character lineup asset, not a cover or collection of little cards.
prompts.portada_a: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a square illustrated board-game COVER PROPOSAL for Noche de Ánimas, concept 'Antes de decir su nombre'. Input 1 is the newly proposed four-person cast: preserve those exact faces, hairstyles, skin tones, ages and clothes. Input 2 is APPROVED deck art and is the authority for illustration finish, texture and moderate detail, not for copying its Ouija scene. Input 3 supplies the haunted Mexican casona architectural identity. Scene: four HUMAN investigators actively deducing a ghost's identity around a wooden table INSIDE the old casona at night. Inés left foreground, dark braid orange flower, ivory floral blouse, magenta rebozo/plum skirt, holds a modest lantern and compares a small evidence card. Rafael green vest short beard red neckerchief opposite her, observing an EMF meter with few simple colored indicators. Tomás teal hat/poncho and moustache, writes on his deduction notebook at right. Mature Amalia cream embroidered rebozo, gray-streaked dark braid and moss skirt at left back, carefully watches a faint handprint on an oval mirror beyond the table. Exactly four living investigators, no fifth person. Table: several face-up illustrated evidence cards, notebook with checkmarks, cassette recorder, small candle; clear individually recognizable objects, no heaps of gear. NO OUIJA, no planchette, no rune circle. Backdrop: teal and burgundy arcade, checkered tile floor, carved wooden door, a few marigolds and simple papel picado. In a rear arch only a partial translucent veiled woman/La Llorona-like silhouette is barely present, matte ghost layers not glowing, creating suspense. The investigators are focused, not all screaming or staring at viewer. Balanced premium cover composition: large legible cream-and-muted-gold decorative serif title at upper area, exact words 'NOCHE DE ÁNIMAS', accurate accented Á, no other words. Ornamental floral corner accents integrated, not dense card rules border. Hierarchy title, four faces, evidence table, distant threat. Match APPROVED deck style: Mexican folk narrative print illustration, paper-collage shapes with illustrated volume and midtones, articulated hands, cloth folds, selective rich ornament, fine printed grain. Cream, teal/petroleum, burgundy, magenta and marigold orange. NO photorealism, realistic skin, glossy highlights, cinematic beams, glows, lens flare, 3D render, flat minimal vectors, black cartoon outlines, excessive microcracks. Lantern and candle illumination is painted color, not luminous rendering. Preserve manageable detail like reference2. One complete cover, no contact sheet, no mockup box, no extra typography or credits.
